title: 宝塚記念の後に・上には上があるものよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One loses the Takarazuka Kinen. Tamamo Cross, despite having taken first place, doesn't lose her hunger for victory in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After experiencing firsthand White Lightning's overwhelming performance, Inari One feels a renewed competitiveness, and she vows to run the Takarazuka Kinen again next year.
